notes: gates.md records no formal gates. The agent approved its own requirements, design and tasks, citing the autonomous delivery note (transcript:31), and no requirement was reversed. The only real stop came at transcript:68, before any code was written: it listed five choices to confirm and one product-owner question, and the owner's answer at transcript:73 changed the spec.
